title: Stalker Arrested After Refusing To Leave Ex Girlfriend Alone
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On November 26th, 2023. An Officer was called to a residence in regard to a woman whose ex husband had been stalking her for months. The cop learned that the man had put a GPS tracker on her vehicle, along with going on her property and physically watching her through fences and such. The man had also been texting her and still pretending  like they were in a relationship. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
